Villa overview

This is a unique contemporary villa located in the exclusive area of Nueva Andalucía, only a 5-minute drive from Puerto Banus, beautiful beaches and great restaurants. This newly renovated villa is built to the highest standard perfectly combining a modern design with Andalusian features.

This is very elegant villa for the discerning client, who wants the best in a minimalistic contemporary style in an open plan lay-out.  The villa has character and high quality.

Totally renovated villa in the sought after Las Brisas Urbanisation, Nueva Andalucia. Total electrical rewiring with only LED lights  (dimmable). All plumbing and main sewage systems fully replaced.  Elegant and unique Apavisa Lapatto microcement floors. Double insulated security glass in ALL windows, Wireless Security system, window security grills wherever applicable. Individually controlled under-floor heating system in all rooms. Easy walking distance to public transportation and shopping.

Unique open courtyard with 400 year old Olive Tree and an entrance door that makes you wonder, if you have come to the right  address. Unique!!

When entering this remarkable villa the modern architecture harmonious floats together with the 400-year-old Olive tree left in peace outside the glass construction. You instantly feel at ease while exploring the rest of this beautiful house. Straight ahead the open plan living area presents itself, where you find a fully equipped kitchen with dining area fitting six and a separate dining area fitting eight people. From the kitchen area, there is direct access to the laundry room with washing machine and tumble dryer. The living room and recreational area is one level down, with beautiful natural light coming in from the full-size windows facing the garden and pool area, creating a smooth transition between indoor and out life.

Outside you have a spacious garden with palm trees, a large heated swimming pool and jacuzzi. The barbecue area is ideal for entertaining and dining under the stars, while the partly covered terrace and lounge seating offers a cosy feel. With total privacy and views towards the mountains, it is genuinely a peaceful haven of paradise, the four bedrooms are positioned well apart for total privacy. All four bedrooms are spacious with king-size beds and great en-suite bathrooms. You will find the impressive master bedroom on the second floor with its mesmerizing view overlooking the valley and the La Concha Mountain

The house is built with quality materials and has unique features such as external and internal lighting with the latest energy saving LED technology. Elegant and unique Porcelain tiles (600x600mm) from Apavisa in the special Lappato finish. All walls with Italian stucco– Six coats of finishes applied to achieve a stunning unique finish. Guest bathrooms in Porcelanosa tiles and sanitary ware. Exclusive hand woven carpet inlays in all bedrooms for comfort. Insulated security glass in ALL windows and venetian blinds in all rooms for light control and privacy. The premises is gated and provided with an alarm system. A private closed parking is provided and connected to the inner part of the plot. This is truly a stunning luxury home.

Features:

A Unique Minimalistic Contemporary Villa • Excellent location - walking distance to shopping • 5 top class golf courses within minutes • Great open floor plan with split level • Property designed for natural ventilation and complemented with air conditioning • Brand New kitchen with Island Bar • Huge fantastic pool • Close to Puerto Banus and many beach options • New outdoor kitchen.
